**Tidbyt Unraid Monitor** — Display live server metrics on your Tidbyt device.
This repository contains a self-contained Docker app that fetches metrics from your Unraid server via the native GraphQL API (Unraid 7.2+) and pushes them directly to your Tidbyt over WiFi.
**Included apps:** - `tidbyt-unraid` — Unraid server metrics dashboard for Tidbyt
**Support:** Open an issue on GitHub or post in the Unraid CA support thread.
